english:
Swinging, waiting 0.6 seconds, then swinging again within 1.5 seconds while grounded grants Argent Blade for 5 seconds.

Argent Blade grants 15% increased Sword Damage and 100 Charge Rate.

The buff cannot be refreshed.

source.text:
Upon swinging, then waiting for 0.6 seconds before swinging again within 1.5 seconds while grounded:
Grants Argent Blade for 5 seconds.
Buff cannot be refreshed.

Argent Blade:
15% Increased Sword Damage
+100 Charge Rate
